title: UK recognises India’s carbon credit trading scheme, relief for Indian exporters
summary: The United Kingdom will recognize India's carbon credit trading scheme. This recognition will help Indian exporters avoid double taxation on goods. British importers can now seek carbon price relief under the UK's mechanism. This move supports India's bid for similar arrangements with the European Union. Cooperation on carbon market design will continue through established partnerships.
